purpose: Teach: 払え/堅い/出れ/きつく/貸す/休ま/おかあさん/かわいく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今月、家賃、しっかり払えるか、心配。
lines.en: I'm worried I won't be able to cover rent this month.
lines.style: Hesitant opening. Quiet admission, not asking for reassurance but letting it out. Breath catches slightly on 'rent.' Vulnerable and a little ashamed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。気持ちは堅いから、大丈夫だよ。
lines.en: Yeah. You've got a strong heart, though. You'll be okay.
lines.style: Warm and steady. Not dismissive — meeting her worry with quiet conviction. Slight lean forward, the reassurance of someone who's listening. Even, grounding pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 家から出れない日も、たまにある。
lines.en: There are days I just can't bring myself to leave the house.
lines.style: Soft, matter-of-fact. Not dramatic. Speaking from inside the experience, not about it. Small trailing-off on 'house' — acknowledging she's shared something vulnerable.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 体調、きつく感じる時、無理しないでね。
lines.en: When your body feels that tight, please don't push yourself, okay?
lines.style: Gentle instruction wrapped in care. No urgency — paced like someone who knows it's important to hear. Warm, slightly protective. Softens on the final question mark.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本、何冊か貸すよ、気晴らしに。
lines.en: I could lend you some books — might give you a little break from your own head.
lines.style: Brightens slightly. A small, genuine offer of help. Not trying to fix her, just extending something small and real. Slight warmth returning to the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 土日、しっかり休まないと、続かない。
lines.en: You can't keep going without proper rest on the weekends. You just can't.
lines.style: Gentle firmness. The second sentence echoes the first with quiet emphasis — not lecturing, just insisting gently. Grounded, like speaking from experience.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うちのおかあさん、いつも電話、心配してくれる。
lines.en: My mom calls all the time, worrying about me.
lines.style: Tender, slightly weary. Recognition of love mixed with the weight of being cared for. Trailing-off at the end — both grateful and a little tired of the worry.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店のロゴ、かわいく刷新されたよね。
lines.en: Oh, and the shop's logo got refreshed — it turned out pretty cute, actually.
lines.style: Gentle tonal shift upward. Softer pivot to something lighter. Small smile in the voice. An offering of normalcy, a way to ease both of them out of the weight. Warm close.
